lead.event: IDX removes high-shareholding-concentration stocks from boards and index evaluations
lead.headline: IDX schedules HSC stock removals from boards and index evaluations, with 346 board exits
lead.blurb: Under the revised test, a stock is classified as high shareholding concentration (HSC) when its 10 largest shareholders collectively own at least 92.5%, with the previous Rp5 trillion market-cap threshold and Price Impact Ratio parameter dropped. IDX announced 4 Acceleration, 233 Development and 109 Main Board constituents exiting. The changes take effect on 30 November for boards and 1 December for index evaluations. HSC stocks have been excluded from the IHSG calculation since 13 November, IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia and the EU sign IEU-CEPA and an investment protection agreement
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia and EU sign IEU-CEPA and investment pact, with 90.4% of lines duty-free
market_structure_policy.blurb: The agreements take effect on 1 January 2027. Another 8.37% of Indonesian tariff lines to the EU will have duties reduced over 3–15 years or through tariff-rate quotas.

market_structure_policy.event: ADHI bond interest delay leads to an IDX trading suspension
market_structure_policy.headline: ADHI defers Rp60.82 billion bond interest as IDX extends trading suspension
market_structure_policy.blurb: The payment was the 18th interest on Adhi Karya’s 2022 Series B and C bonds, due 24 November. Bondholders rejected an installment plan for the 17th, 18th and 19th interest obligations at meetings on 6 August and 30 October. Adhi Karya plans another bondholder meeting and will coordinate with trustee Bank Mega.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: ADHI deferred Rp60,824,400,000 in bond interest and IDX extended the suspension of its shares across all markets.

earnings_guidance.event: BRIS reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS reports nine-month 2026 net profit up 10.02% to Rp6.13 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Operating expenses rose 17%, limiting pre-provision operating profit growth to 2% at Rp10 trillion. Lower provisioning costs also supported earnings, while management cut its net interest margin guidance to 5.3%-5.5% from above 5.5%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: Operating expenses rose 17%, limiting pre-provision operating profit growth to 2%.

earnings_guidance.event: MDKA reports a return to profit in 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: MDKA returns to profit with US$157 million net profit in 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Copper Gold posted Q3 revenue of US$858 million, up 10% quarter on quarter, and cumulative revenue of US$2.26 billion, up 76%, through September. Phintraco Sekuritas sees up to 122% upside for the shares.

earnings_guidance.headline: ARCI reports nine-month 2026 profit of US$108.93 million, up 54.57%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Archi's cash and cash equivalents rose 163.38% year on year to US$61.69 million. Revenue increased 39.70% to US$459.21 million, while gross profit rose 42.09% to US$202.91 million.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: Cash and cash equivalents rose 163.38% year on year to US$61.69 million.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: APIC plans a bond issue of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: APIC plans bond issue of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pacific Strategic Financial would use Rp400 billion to repay its principal debt to SMBC Indonesia, with the remainder funding investment portfolio development in financial instruments and financial services companies. Series A matures on 17 January 2028 and Series B on 7 January 2030, with fixed quarterly interest and bullet principal repayment.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: IGAR plans a share buyback as part of its go-private and delisting process
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: IGAR plans Rp163.44 billion buyback for go-private and delisting process
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The planned purchase covers up to 155.66 million public shares, about 16.78% of fully placed and paid-up shares, at Rp1,050 each. Champion Pacific says the transition is intended to improve operational efficiency and competitiveness and that it has no plans to seek capital-market funding in the foreseeable future. IDX suspended trading in IGAR shares on 16 October.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BUAT IPO offering and prospectus disclosures
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Bumi Atsiri Prima plans IPO of up to 534 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bumi Atsiri Prima's prospectus reports negative operating cash flow of Rp118 billion, and auditors flagged Rp124.7 billion in receivables without an impairment reserve. Shares are priced at Rp135–Rp190, with maximum proceeds of Rp101.46 billion targeted for working capital.
